title: Cities: Skylines II (Paradox Interactive; Colossal Order / Iceflake Studios; Windows PC, out since 24 Oct 2023) is free to play on Steam from Thu 12 Nov to Mon 16 Nov 2026, also on Steam's India store; minimum PC: 8 GB RAM, GTX 970 (4 GB) or RX 480 (8 GB), 60 GB disk; the paid Park Adventures expansion (city parks, zoos, nature reserves, amusement park rides, 100+ assets, new maps, park finances) launches on PC (Steam, Microsoft Store) on 2 Dec 2026 and is included in Expansion Pass II.

sources.outlet: Steam (Cities: Skylines II store page, India store, cc=in)
Paradox Interactive (Cities: Skylines II official page, system requirements)
Paradox Interactive (Steam community announcement: 'Park Adventures is coming Dec 2, 2026!')

Steam's India store lists the free-play: https://store.steampowered.com/app/949230/ (fetched with cc=in, 04:53 IST 13 Nov: 'Play for free until 16 Nov @ 10:00am'; prices on the page in INR)
Windows PC only on Steam; no Mac version: https://store.steampowered.com/app/949230/ (platforms: windows true, mac false, linux false)

left_out: Rupee price (Rs 3,139, 30% off to Rs 2,197, 'Offer ends 19 November') is on Steam's India store at 04:50-04:53 IST 13 Nov, but no second source could be reached (SteamDB and IsThereAnyDeal return 403; no outlet prints the INR price), so per G1 condition 3 no price, discount or sale date appears. The DLC's price is not listed on Steam India yet, and no $ price is used. Seasonal Shift patch and console versions (single source) cut. No claim about progress carrying over.
